verdict.rationale: SigNoz delivers AI-driven insights from your data, but through external AI agents rather than inside its own UI. Its official MCP server and Agent Skills give Claude, Cursor and Copilot natural-language access to metrics, logs, traces and alerts. Documented use cases include investigating what changed after a deploy, tuning a noisy alert, and creating dashboards from natural language. Nothing in the evidence shows a native in-product assistant or automatically surfaced suggestions, so the story is only partly met and needs a third-party agent. Missing for 10: a native in-product AI assistant or insights panel, AI suggestions surfaced directly in the SigNoz UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI use cases.
